summary: Inongo territory (Maï-Ndombe) covers Inongo town, the provincial capital, and the Inongo, Banzow Moke and Ntandembelo secteurs around Lake Maï-Ndombe. No armed group is reported to control any locality: the town is held by the PNC with FARDC elements, and rural villages fall under ordinary state presence (PNC posts) with customary chiefs. The Mobondo (Teke-Yaka) militia remains active in mid-2026 in Kwamouth and neighbouring areas to the south-west, the nearest risk for Ntandembelo, but is not reported inside Inongo territory. Web research was unavailable for this run, so rural assessments rest on default state presence with low confidence.

sources.title: «Les Mobondo ne sont jamais partis» - Dans l'ouest, ce groupe qui sévit toujours malgré le discours officiel
Le Gouvernement confirme des signaux de paix face au phénomène Mobondo !

zones.description: Inongo town, provincial capital of Maï-Ndombe
zones.evidence: Inongo is the seat of Maï-Ndombe provincial institutions on Lake Maï-Ndombe, with PNC provincial command and FARDC elements; no armed group is reported to hold or regularly operate in the town. The Mobondo militia active since 2022 is centred on Kwamouth territory far to the south-west.

zones.description: Rural Inongo secteur and Banzow Moke secteur around Lake Maï-Ndombe (Inongo, Banzow Moke and Kiri health-zone villages)
zones.evidence: No reports of armed-group control in the lake-side secteurs of Inongo territory; order rests on PNC posts and customary chiefs. Research was limited for this run (search budget exhausted, sources blocked).

zones.description: Ntandembelo secteur (south-west, toward Mushie/Kwamouth and the Kasai/Congo rivers)
zones.evidence: Ntandembelo lies closest to the Mobondo-affected Kwamouth/Mushie area, but Mobondo is not reported to hold localities in Inongo territory; Mobondo holdouts were still reported in mid-2026 mainly in Kwamouth and adjacent Kwilu/Kinshasa fringes. Assessed as ordinary state presence with low confidence.
